From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 1 Aug 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Operational plugfest + OKR check — docs lock, pricing edge cases, support SLA

Team —

Quick sync to close the loop ahead of the Turnstile Health pilot next week. High-level asks and owners below; please respond inline with any blocker you need covered by EOD. This thread will become our single source for last-mile ops and QBR notes.

1) Docs lock + plugfest (owner: Olga) — we need a content freeze for the published runbook and the customer-facing MOP today so we can run the plugfest with the GTM and support squads tomorrow. Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-launch-assets

2) Pricing edge cases (owner: Kimberly) — Turnstile asked about metering behavior for concurrent sessions and cached-prefix billing. We need clarified language for the quote and an SLA exception matrix if they push for committed units.

3) Enablement + demos (owner: Marissa) — confirm playbook for demo environment access, scripts for failure scenarios, and a 30-min enablement for customer ops the day after go-live.

4) Support readiness (owner: Sean) — we need triage runbook, on-call rotation for the first 72 hours, and escalation hooks into the infra team (Vivek will sit on the 1st shift). Please attach the runbook draft.

5) Exec escalation / QBR artifacts (owner: Marcus) — capture the top 3 success metrics we'll include in the QBR (latency p50/p95, per-token unit cost delta, activation rate). Also include the HubSpot deal id HS-54912 for tracking.

Attachments: turnstile_mop_v1.pdf, sla-exceptions.xlsx, support-runbook-draft.md

Immediate asks (action by EOD):
- Olga: confirm doc freeze timestamp and send final plugfest invite.
- Kimberly: send suggested language for quote and note any SLA exceptions.
- Marissa: confirm demo roster + time.
- Sean: attach the runbook link and confirm on-call schedule for Aug 4-6.
- Marcus: confirm QBR metric list and whether we need an exec pre-brief.

Thanks — I want us to be under one thread for any last-minute items. I will collate for the Monday QBR prep.

—Naomi
Naomi Feldman

Thanks Naomi — quick responses from my side:
- QBR metrics: p50/p95 latency (live traffic), token unit cost delta (baseline vs quantized), activation conversion at day 3. I also want an anomaly count metric (regressions flagged by quality checks).
- Exec pre-brief: yes, please — 20 minutes with Jen (SVP) on Monday at 09:00 PT. I can draft a 1-slide summary if someone wants to own it with me.

I'll be on the plugfest to run the traffic profiles. No blockers from product other than confirmation on the exact sequence length to test for (we should include 512 and 2048).
